integrity: Proof uses a two-case strict ordinal reduction, a direct EFX completion lemma, and two indistinguishable-input upper witnesses. Exact finite checks supplement rather than replace the universal mathematical proof. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Known horizon of exactly three goods; two agents; singleton values of the arriving good observable to both; oblivious fixed instance; complete terminal EFX rather than prefix fairness; no incentive guarantee; the upper-bound witnesses are additive while the policy lower bound allows all monotone nonnegative valuations.
title: The sharp one-half success frontier for online EFX with two agents and three goods
